_comment_authMode: EntraKerberos = cloud-only or hybrid users, no DC needed, ~10h TGT ceiling. ADDS = on-prem Kerberos, hybrid users only, requires DC line of sight, no TGT ceiling. Omitting this key defaults to EntraKerberos.
_comment_adds: Only used when authMode is ADDS. netBiosDomainName is the pre-Windows-2000 name (e.g. CONTOSO), NOT the FQDN - the portal gets this wrong and it breaks Kerberos.
_comment_tgt: Only used when authMode is EntraKerberos. The ADDS path skips all of this - on-prem TGTs renew natively.
